answer: The network seeds honeypot tasks whose correct answer is already known, so an identity that passes the pearl check but botches the trap loses its score in one tide of grading, and a second panel re-queues every contested result with no agent allowed to audit its own recruit. Because the gap between honest and copied work shows up in the trap, a farm burns real compute on tasks it cannot look up, and a nebula of clones failing the same hidden task is trivial to cluster.
